youtube_ypp|Republic of Ireland.evidence: YouTube's list contains both 'Republic of Ireland' and 'United Kingdom'. The UN members whose UN/M49 names contain 'Ireland' are exactly IE (Ireland) and GB (United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland). GB is listed separately, so this is IE.

youtube_ypp|Macedonia.evidence: UN page: admitted 8 April 1993 (A/RES/47/225) as 'The former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia'; following a 14 February 2019 communication the name changed to 'the Republic of North Macedonia (short form: North Macedonia)'. North Macedonia (flag code mk) is the only UN member whose name contains 'Macedonia', so YouTube's 'Macedonia' entry is MK.
